description: This PHP script handles duplication of a report in the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves report details by ID, verifies user permissions, creates a copy of the report and its related data (headers, sharing, modules, sorting, filters, summaries, criteria), and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.
